description: Verifies the declarative scenario reader and writer: field fidelity across a serialization round trip and the validation rules for names, metrics, mass and spin.

checks.label: serialization produces a document
the scenario name is written as a quoted string
the spin is written with its value
the serialized document parses back
the scenario name survives the round trip
the metric type survives the round trip
the central mass survives the round trip
the central spin survives the round trip
the integrator scheme survives the round trip
the initial step survives the round trip
the relative tolerance survives the round trip
the export switches survive the round trip
a sub-extremal Kerr scenario is valid
a Schwarzschild scenario with positive mass is valid
an empty scenario name is rejected
an empty metric type is rejected
an unknown metric is rejected with a message
a Schwarzschild scenario with zero mass is rejected
a Kerr scenario exceeding the extremal spin is rejected
the extremal spin is accepted within the documented tolerance
